item.title: Finance Coach Warns: Anyone Claiming “Insider Knowledge” on XRP Is Fake
item.description: A finance coach has issued a warning to XRP holders to be wary of influencers who claim to have insider knowledge regarding Ripple and XRP. The XRP community remains one of the largest and most active in the crypto space, and this has subjected it to multiple scam attempts and a surge of influencers seeking to capitalize on impressions.Visit Website

item.title: Strategy’s Latest 1,142 Bitcoin Buy Already at an $11M Loss
